administrative_timing.clock_anchor: receipt by the proper component, but not later than 10 working days after first receipt by a designated USDA component
administrative_timing.determination_not_production_boundary: The 20-working-day target concerns the determination and does not necessarily require completion of production.
administrative_timing.tolling_boundary: Record clarification and fee toll start and end separately; do not silently restart the 20-working-day clock.
administrative_timing.timing_boundary: Record agency dates and notices exactly; this contract does not determine exhaustion, timeliness compliance, or legal entitlement.

appeal_contract.appeal_boundary: A no-records response is appealable but does not establish zero domain outcomes; liaison or OGIS contact does not replace a timely administrative appeal.
